messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Rhipe on EMR
parts:
Hello All,

Heads up, I will be playing with the EMR scripts to to make them work smoothly with Elastic MapReduce. In particular

- i want quicker startup times
- i will encourage the approach of installing R packages on the main node, creating an R distribution and using distributed cache to use it.
- automate the permissions

Will report on progress
Spatarshi
